# ISTER Limousine Service

> Premium Mercedes-Benz Chauffeur Service in Budapest: immaculate luxury fleet, professional English-speaking drivers, and 24/7 reliability for corporate and private VIP travel. Airport transfers, city-to-city journeys, hourly bookings and private tours.

Operated by BUD EVENT KFT, licensed passenger transport company (NT-01-669), 1052 Budapest, Deák Ferenc utca 17., Hungary.

## Contact

- Phone and WhatsApp: +36 30 601 2000
- Email: info@isterbudapest.com
- Request a quote: /#get-a-quote

## Prices

Fixed prices in euros per vehicle, tax and tolls included.

- Budapest Airport (BUD) transfer, either direction: E-Class €75, V-Class €85, S-Class €115
- Hourly chauffeur, minimum 2 hours: E-Class €65, V-Class €75, S-Class €115 per hour
- Private tour Discover Budapest (Mercedes V-Class): 4 hours €300, 5 hours €375, 8 hours €600
